fields.process: Component purchase order to delivered furniture
fields.scope: Starts when the season's range plan is signed off, ends when the customer has the furniture in their home

nodes.title: Range and demand plan
nodes.detail: Category team sets the season's assortment and volumes

nodes.title: Purchase order to panel supplier
nodes.detail: Sourcing places orders against the plan

nodes.title: Inbound freight and goods receipt
nodes.detail: Containers arrive at the port and are booked into stock

nodes.title: Production and assembly scheduling
nodes.detail: Plants schedule cutting, edge-banding and packing

nodes.title: Finished goods to distribution centre
nodes.detail: Pallets move from plant to the regional DC

nodes.title: Customer delivery and installation
nodes.detail: Two-person crews deliver and assemble in the home

nodes.title: ERP (SAP S/4HANA)
nodes.detail: Purchase orders, BOMs and stock; supplier lead times maintained by hand

nodes.title: Carrier and supplier portal
nodes.detail: Container milestones arrive as EDI messages and PDFs; no event stream

nodes.title: Plant MES
nodes.detail: Line and machine schedules; three plants on separate instances

nodes.title: Delivery app photos
nodes.detail: Crew handover photos, unstructured, three years retained

nodes.title: Season forecast misses on new ranges
nodes.detail: Slow movers hold 22% of DC space; markdowns run at 6% of revenue

nodes.title: Container delays surface too late
nodes.detail: Carrier ETA is up to 5 days stale, so plants replan on rumour

nodes.title: One short component replans the week
nodes.detail: 1 in 6 production weeks is rescheduled; ~EUR 8k changeover cost per event

nodes.title: Damage on bulky last-mile delivery
nodes.detail: 4.1% of deliveries end in a damage claim, ~EUR 240 per replacement

nodes.title: SKU-level demand forecast
nodes.detail: Forecasts season volumes per SKU and region so the range plan starts from a number, not a hunch

nodes.title: Container delay early warning
nodes.detail: Predicts arrival slippage from carrier events so the plant replans once, not weekly

nodes.title: Component shortage risk flag
nodes.detail: Flags the parts likely to be short before the schedule freezes

nodes.title: Damage claim photo triage
nodes.detail: Reads the handover photo and routes the claim without a human first look

nodes.title: Supplier lead times have no owner
nodes.detail: They are maintained by hand in the ERP; every forecast inherits that error

nodes.title: Three plants, three MES instances
nodes.detail: Any scheduling model needs a harmonised feed before it needs a model
